# vyos.blueprints.bgp_unnumbered

BGP IPv6 unnumbered with extended next-hop (docs blueprint of the same name)

- Peers over IPv6 link-local addresses on each listed interface, carries IPv4 and IPv6 with extended next-hop, and redistributes connected routes. Parallel links give ECMP; `multipath-relax` allows it across different neighbour ASes.
- Puts the router-id as a /32 on `lo`, as in the page's results.
- AS, router-id and redistribution use vyos.vyos BGP modules. Peer-group, interface (v6only) neighbours and multipath-relax use vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because the BGP resource modules cannot express them yet.
- Works for any number of routers; each router lists only its own links.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.bgp_unnumbered
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bgp_unnumbered_asn` | int | yes |  | Local AS number (`system-as`). |
| `bgp_unnumbered_router_id` | str | yes |  | BGP router-id; also configured as a /32 on `lo`. |
| `bgp_unnumbered_interfaces` | list | yes |  | Interfaces to peer on, e.g. `[eth1, eth2]`. They need no IP address. |
| `bgp_unnumbered_peer_group` | str |  | `fabric` | Peer-group name shared by all unnumbered neighbours. |
| `bgp_unnumbered_remote_as` | str |  | `external` | `external`, `internal` or an AS number. |
| `bgp_unnumbered_address_families` | list |  | `[ipv4, ipv6]` | Address families activated on the peer-group. |
| `bgp_unnumbered_redistribute` | list |  | `[connected]` | Route types redistributed in every listed address family. |
| `bgp_unnumbered_multipath_relax` | bool |  | `true` | Set `bestpath as-path multipath-relax`. |
| `bgp_unnumbered_group` | str |  | `''` | Inventory group of all routers in the fabric; used only by `verify`. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify` against all routers in the same play. Checks one established session per listed interface and, with `bgp_unnumbered_group`, a BGP route to every other router-id. When the group has exactly two routers, also checks one ECMP next hop per link.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bgp_unnumbered_router_id` | str | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
| `bgp_unnumbered_interfaces` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
| `bgp_unnumbered_group` | str |  | `''` | Same value as for `main`. |
